subject: Urgent: candidate missed slot — proposal to split today's panel into micro-sessions + async task
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate no-show for 10:00am — quick options

Team — quick heads-up: Elena Garcia (phone +1-415-555-0132) did not join her 10:00am panel slot. I left a voicemail at 10:07am and sent a follow-up text; no response yet. Her resume + current calendar invite attached.

Options I’m proposing to keep the pipeline moving:
- Try a 20-min technical phone screen today with a single interviewer (Aditya) and then pivot to a 2-hour take-home if that goes well.
- If she’s unavailable today, offer two condensed micro-interviews (30m each) tomorrow morning to replace the 90m panel.
- As a fallback, send an async coding task with a 48-hour turnaround and a short synchronous debrief once she submits.

I think momentum matters here — she’s been responsive until today. Tagging Grace for hiring-direction and Aditya for feasibility. I can re-open the slot if we decide to wait.

Attachments: elena_garcia_resume.pdf, calendar-invite-20270605.ics

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate no-show for 10:00am — quick options

Thanks Marissa. If she's truly unavailable today I’m okay with a short triage screen to avoid losing momentum. Prefer this flow:
1) Aditya — 20-min phone screen today (technical fit; quick red flags)
2) If green, email candidate a 2-hour take-home coding assignment with a 48-hour window
3) If take-home looks good, schedule the remaining interviewers for 30-min micro-sessions next week for deeper system-design and collaboration questions.

Aditya — are you able to do a 20-min slot between 11:00–12:30 today? If not, we’ll go async.

-Grace
Grace O'Connor
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

P.S. Keep an eye on candidate enthusiasm in voicemail/texts — if the reasoning is vague we may deprioritize for now.
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate no-show for 10:00am — quick options

I can take a 20-min screen at 11:15am today.
Agenda: 10m resume/behavior + 10m targeted coding/design question. If she can’t do 11:15, I’m also available 1:00–1:30pm.

If we run live and it’s promising I’ll write up a ~2-hour take-home that focuses on LLM inference batching/throughput (aligned to the role). I’ll attach a short micro-interview plan after the call.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Software Engineer (Interviewer)
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate no-show for 10:00am — quick options

Thanks — good triage. Marissa, please send Elena two options in one text/email: 1) an 11:15 phone screen with Aditya (live, 20m), or 2) a 2-hr take-home with a 48-hour turnaround. Ask for a firm yes/no on 11:15 by 10:50am so we don’t sit idle. I’ll hold Aditya’s 11:15 slot tentatively.

If she accepts the 11:15 now, we’ll treat the live screen as the canonical next step. If she asks for later today, we can offer 1:00pm as backup. If she asks to postpone >24 hours, go straight to take-home.

I’m attaching a brief micro-interview plan (micro-interview-plan.docx) we can use for the condensed slots if we need them next week. Also dropping the HubSpot contact: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ELENA-9832

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Talent Strategy | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate no-show for 10:00am — proposal to split today's panel into micro-sessions + async task

Hi Marissa / Sean — I am so sorry. My toddler had a sudden high fever this morning and I had to take him to urgent care; I missed the SMS and call because I stepped away. I really want to continue with this process — could I do the 11:15 phone screen with Aditya now? If that’s too tight, I can do 1:00pm today or 9:00am tomorrow. I can also accept the take-home if you prefer that route.

Again, apologies for the disruption — I’m still very interested. Please tell me what works and I’ll confirm immediately.

Thanks,
Elena Garcia
elena.garcia@gmail.com
+1-415-555-0132
